data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
Prescribing volume is a key indicator of clinical practice and medicines optimisation. The Top 50 Paragraphs by Items Prescriber Report in ePACT2 provides authorised users with a ranked view of the 50 BNF paragraphs with the highest number of items prescribed by each prescriber.

This report enables organisations to monitor prescribing activity across therapeutic areas, identify high-volume prescribing patterns, and assess whether these align with clinical guidance. Users can filter data by prescriber and time period, supporting detailed analysis and benchmarking against regional and national averages. The report is particularly useful for identifying areas where prescribing volume may indicate overuse, underuse, or opportunities for improvement.

The aim of this report is to provide transparency and support medicines optimisation by highlighting prescribing behaviour at paragraph level. It helps prescribers and commissioners understand which therapeutic areas dominate prescribing activity and whether variation is clinically justified. While the report offers valuable insights, it should be used alongside other dashboards and clinical data to inform decisions. Its intention is to encourage best practice, reduce unwarranted variation, and improve patient outcomes across the NHS.
